source: Yikes! A monster?!
comment: あ、あれって魔獣…！？

source: Huh... Never seen this kind before.
comment: ふむ、見たことのない種類だが。

source:
It looks like a Flying Feline.
 Careful, everyone.
comment:
トビネコだな…
 気を引き締めていこう。

source:
Please tell me there aren't more of
 those things lurking around here...
comment:
うう…今みたいなのが
 何匹もうろついてるのかな…

source:
I hate to tell you, but I can sense
 more further in.
comment:
気配を感じる…
 間違いなさそうだ。

source: Anyway, let's just stay alert.
comment: とにかく、焦らず先に進もう。

source:
I'm starting to lose my sense
 of direction down here...
comment:
本当に地下道って感じだよね…
 方向感覚がなくなってきたかも…

source:
Yeah. Gotta make sure we're
 not going in circles.
comment: ああ、気をつけて進まないとな。

source:
What's a place like this even
 doing on the school grounds?
comment:
しかし、どうして学院の敷地に
 こんな場所があるんだ？

source:
Yeah... Who puts a giant trap
 door in a campus building?
comment:
そうだよねぇ…
 落とし穴まで用意してるし。

source:
Looks like the path splits. Which
 way do you think we should go?
comment:
分かれ道か…
 どちらに行ったものかな。

source:
I feel a little wind blowing from the
 east. I'd bet the exit's that way.
comment: 風を感じる…出口は東側のようだ。

source:
(He seems kinda...imposing. I don't
 know how to break the ice...)
comment: （う、うーん…話しかけづらいかも…）

source:
(He seems kinda...imposing. I don't
 know how to break the ice...) [[Elliot] #15]
comment: （う、うーん…話しかけづらいかも…）

source:
Bah... I feel like we've just
 been going in circles.
comment:
くっ…さっきから同じ場所を
 歩き続けている気がするぞ…

source:
You might be right. Maybe we should
 check where we are on the map.
comment:
ああ…いったん地図で
 位置を確認した方がよさそうだ。

source:
I feel like we've simply
 been running in circles.
comment:
チッ…さっきから同じ場所を
 歩き続けているようだな。

source:
You might be right. Maybe we should
 check where we are on the map. [[Rean] #19]
comment:
ああ…いったん地図で
 位置を確認した方がよさそうだ。

source: Wow, check out all these stalls!
comment:
あはは、色んな屋台があって
 目移りしちゃうね。

source:
Oooh. The lace at that stall
 has a really pretty design.
comment:
うーん、今のレース、
 すごく良い柄だったわね。

source: Mishy...? I admit, it has a certain charm.
comment:
みっしぃ…？
 妙に心惹かれる造形だな。

source:
All these windmills sure make
 the town feel pretty laid back.
comment:
風車がたくさん…
 ふふっ、のどかでいいわね。

source:
True. The scenery is surprisingly
 relaxing.
comment: うん、癒される光景だな。

source:
This would be a really tranquil
 area...if not for the monsters.
comment:
こっちものどかだね…
 やっぱり魔獣はいるみたいだけど。

source: Yeah. Let's be careful.
comment: まあ、気をつけて行こう。

source: Is this a farmhouse?
comment: ここは…農家のようだな。

source: Huh. I wonder where we are...
comment: あれ、なんだろう、ここ…

source:
Hmm... It says,
 'Lunaria Nature Park.'
comment:
ふむ、『ルナリア自然公園』
 と書かれているようだが。

source: Wow. This farmhouse is huge.
comment: へえ…大きな農家ね。

source: Haha. Look at the cows! ♪
comment: あはは、牛がいるよ♪

source:
The Transcontinental Railroad, huh?
 Guess that'll take you out of the country.
comment:
大陸横断鉄道…
 外国に通じているんだったな。

source:
Yeah. If you keep on heading east, you'd
 eventually reach Garrelia Fortress.
comment:
ええ…このずっと先に
 東の国境、ガレリア要塞があるわ。

source:
We should take a right here
 to reach the nature park.
comment: 自然公園は、ここを右手だな。

source: Right. Let's go!
comment: ええ、行ってみましょう…！

source:
There's tons of little stone
 monuments in here...
comment:
なんか、小さな石碑が
 あちこちにあるけど…

source:
Yeah. What do you think
 they're supposed to be?
comment: ええ…何なのかしら？

source:
I imagine they were made by
 the animists in this province.
comment:
多分、この地方にあった
 精霊信仰の名残だろう。

source: This way's a dead end.
comment: こちらは行き止まりか。

source:
Yeah... This park covers a lot
 more area than I was expecting.
comment:
ああ…思った以上に
 奥深いみたいだな。

source:
Oh, there's a stream here.
 This seems like a nice spot.
comment: 小川か…少しほっとするわね。

source: I can't sense anyone in this area.
comment:
この辺りに
 人の気配はないようだ。

source: Just how deep does this forest go?
comment:
こ、この森、
 どこまで続いてるのかな…

source:
We must be pretty far in now.
 I'd imagine we're almost there.
comment:
かなり進んだはずだ。
 あと一息だろう。

source:
Oh, hey! There's an orbment
 charging station!
comment:
あっ…！
 回復装置があるわ…！

source:
We must be in the most remote
 reaches of the park.
comment: ああ…どうやら終点みたいだ。

source: Who's this a statue of?
comment: この像、ナニ？

source:
It seems to be a statue
 of St. Veronica.
comment:
聖女ヴェロニカの像、
 みたいですね。

source: Oh? You know of her?
comment: ほう、詳しいな。

source:
*sigh* I love the look of this
 city. It's so beautiful...
comment:
はぁ…
 本当に綺麗な街並みですね。

source:
Maybe so, but it's got nothing on
 Heimdallr in terms of sheer scale.
comment:
フン…規模は帝都の方が
 はるかに上だがな。

source:
Is this the way to
 the city's airport?
comment:
この先は…
 飛行船の発着場みたいだな。

source:
It is, though I doubt we'll have
 any reason to go there.
comment: ああ、今回は用はあるまい。

source: This seems to be the city's noble quarter.
comment:
この辺りは…貴族の方々が
 住んでいるみたいですね。

source:
No wonder most of these houses
 look so overblown and excessive.
comment:
フン、どうりでお高く止まった
 屋敷が多いわけだ。

source: Wait, this leads to...
comment: おい、そちらは…

source: Huh? What's wrong?
comment: ？ どうしたんだ？

source: ...Never mind.
comment: …いや、何でもない。

source:
This street seems kinda
 different from the others.
comment: ここ、ちょっと雰囲気違うね。

source:
This is Artisans' Street, where craftsmen
 and merchants ply their trades.
comment:
職人通り…
 様々な店が軒を連ねているな。

source: Oh, a lake.
comment: あ、池がある。

source: Heehee. It looks so pretty.
comment: ふふっ、綺麗ですね。

source: A bridge, huh?
comment: この橋は…

source:
Saar Bridge. Beyond here is out
 of bounds for our field study.
comment:
ザール橋…
 実習範囲はここまでだ。

source:
That bridge above us looks like it
 dates back to the Middle Ages.
comment:
上にあるのは…
 中世の橋梁みたいだな。

source:
It is. It's been there for
 several hundred years.
comment: ああ、数百年前のものだ。

source:
This looks like quite an old road,
 though it does seem well reinforced.
comment:
古い道みたいですけど…
 かなり補強がされていますね。

source:
Yup... Looks like a lot of
 armored vehicles come this way.
comment: ん…車両も結構通ってるみたい。

source: I didn't notice there was a path here...
comment: こんな所に道が…

source:
The monster we're looking
 for should be just ahead.
comment:
手配された魔獣は
 この先みたいだな。

source: We're finally back.
comment: やっと戻って来た。

source: Whew... My feet are killing me.
comment:
ふぅ…
 さすがに歩き疲れましたね。

source:
Just the kind of thing you'd
 expect in an old ruin like this.
comment:
いかにも中世の遺跡っぽい
 ギミックだね。

source:
Do you think it's powered by
 the water flowing through here?
comment:
ええ、水の力を
 使ってるんでしょうか。

source:
The entrance to the guardhouse is
 to the west. We should hurry.
comment:
領邦軍の詰所は西だ。
 …とにかく急ぐぞ。

source: *pant* Why is this ladder so long?
comment:
ふぅふぅ…
 ずいぶん長い梯子ですね。

source:
Is it harder to climb ladders
 when you've got a big chest?
comment:
やっぱり胸が大きいと
 登りにくい？

source: F-Fie...!
comment: フィ、フィーちゃん…///

source: There's another lattice door...
comment: また格子扉か…

source:
There should be a mechanism
 to open it somewhere nearby.
comment:
近くの仕掛けで開くはずだ。
 探してみるぞ。

source: Whew... I'm exhausted...
comment: はぁ…ちょっと疲れました。

source: It's gotta be the chest...
comment: やっぱり胸が…

source: Fie, that's enough.
comment:
フィー。
 そのくらいにしなさい。

source: ...Honestly.
comment: …まったく。

source:
Ugh. If I hadn't been so careless,
 this would never have happened...
comment:
クッ、しかし油断しなければ
 こんな事態には…

source: There wasn't much you could've done.
comment: あの場合は仕方ないさ。

source: Heehee. I'm just glad you're all right.
comment:
ふふっ…
 とにかく無事で良かったです。

source: That's the wrong way...!
comment: そっちは違う…！

source: We need to head east! Hurry!
comment: 東へまっすぐだ、急ぐぞ！

source: Yoohoo!
comment: やっほ──…っ！

source: Heehee. You're as excited as a child.
comment:
ふふっ、アリサさん、
 子供みたい。

source:
Ahaha. I think I'm just
 caught up in the moment.
comment:
あはは、ちょっと
 ハイになってるみたい。

source: The sun's almost down...
comment: 日が落ちてきたな…

source:
We're almost at the settlement.
 Let's keep up the pace, guys.
comment:
集落までもう少しだ。
 このまま飛ばすとしよう。

source: Heehee. Look at all the sheep here.
comment:
ふふっ…
 羊がたくさんですね。

source: Watching them makes me feel so...content.
comment: うーん、癒されるわね。

source: You have an orbal truck here?
comment:
へえ、導力車も
 使っているんだな？

source: Looks like an old-model Reinford truck.
comment:
ラインフォルト製の
 古い運搬車みたいだけど…

source:
Yup. It was donated to the
 settlement a few years ago.
comment:
数年前、とある人が
 寄贈してくれたものでな。

source:
I'm surprised to see a river
 running at this elevation.
comment:
ほう…こんな高地にも
 川が流れているのか。

source: It's fed from the lake to the north.
comment:
ああ、北にある湖から
 流れてきたものだ。

source:
I figured there'd be monsters
 around. Be careful, everyone.
comment:
やはり魔獣が出ている…
 気をつけて行くとしよう。

source: Got it.
comment: ああ、了解だ…！

source: Umm... Isn't this the way to...?
comment: えっと、こちらの方って…

source:
This path leads to the stone
 circle you saw yesterday.
comment:
このまま道沿いに回ると
 昨日の石柱群にたどり着くな。

source: Is this the way to the watchtower?
comment: 監視塔とやらはこの先か。

source: Yeah. Just keep heading along this path.
comment:
ああ、このまま
 道沿いに行けばいい。

source: Well...here we are...
comment: や、やっと門に着いたわね…

source:
Let's go meet with the
 lieutenant general.
comment:
ああ…
 中将から話を聞いてみよう。

source: That's...
comment: あれが…

source: It looks like a Calvard military base.
comment: 共和国軍の基地みたいですね…

source:
It is. This area kind of acts as a
 buffer zone between the two countries.
comment:
ああ…ちょうどこの辺りが
 緩衝地帯になっているらしい。

source: There's mist in the distance...
comment: モヤが立っているな…

source:
Yeah. It's even higher here
 than the southern highlands.
comment:
ああ、南よりも
 さらに高地なんだろう。

source: Wow... That's one towering waterfall.
comment:
わぁ…あの滝、
 凄い高さから落ちてるわね。

source:
I'll say. It must be at
 least a 500 arge drop.
comment:
ええ、５００アージュくらい
 落差がありそうですね…

source:
Oh, it's a plateau. I guess
 this way's a dead end.
comment:
高台か…
 こちらは行き止まりだな。

source:
Ahhh... I love how refreshing
 the wind feels here.
comment: ふふっ、風が気持ちいいですね。

source:
Oh... We made it all the way
 to where the giant statue is.
comment: あ…像の正面に来たわね。

source:
It looks even more massive
 the closer we get.
comment: ああ、それにしても大きいな…

source:
To get right in front of it, we'll
 need to go around the cliff.
comment:
像の前に行くには
 左右から回り込む必要があるな。

source: I'm glad to be back here again.
comment: ふぅ…ホッとしますね。

source:
Agreed. I'm certainly
 in no hurry to return.
comment:
フン…
 辛気臭い場所だったな。

source: How beautiful...
Yeah... Breathtaking.
comment: 素敵な場所ですね…

source:
Man, I'd love to get in
 a little fishing here.
comment:
うーん…
 釣りがしたくなるな。

source: Well, no one's stopping you.
comment: 別に止めはしないぞ。

source: This is...
comment: ここは…

source: It's so gloomy in here...
comment: な、なんか薄暗いわね…

source:
That's one of the Imperial
 Army's airships...
comment:
帝国軍が運用している
 軍用飛行艇だわ…

source:
This situation is looking
 worse by the minute.
comment:
フン、思った以上に
 キナ臭くなっているな。

source: ...We need to hurry.
comment: …とにかく急ぐぞ。

source:
Those are armored cars
 from the Imperial Army...!
comment: 帝国軍の導力装甲車…！

source: Damn... This isn't looking good...
comment: クッ、このままじゃ…

source: We can't let them get away!
comment: このまま行かせるものか…！

source: Right! We need to overtake them!
comment:
ああ！
 何としても追いつこう！

source: Crap... They're fast!
comment: くっ、速い…！

source: Just don't lose sight of them!
comment: ともかく見失うな…！

source:
Did they touch down near
 the stone circle...?
comment:
せ、石柱群のあたりに
 降りたんでしょうか…！？

source: Grrr... There's no escape for them now!
comment:
くうう～…
 絶対に追いつくわよっ！

source: Woohoooooo! This is amaaaziiiiiing!
comment:
ひゃっほう！
 あはは、気持ちいーね！

source:
*sigh* If you keep squirming around
 back there, you're going to fall off.
comment:
はあ…あんまりはしゃいで
 落ちないようにな？

source:
Mmm... If we keep up this pace,
 we might make it in time after all.
comment:
うーん、この速度なら
 何とか間に合いそうかな？

source: Not might. We WILL make it in time.
comment:
ああ…
 必ず間に合わせてみせる！

source: The ancient quarry is this way, right?
comment: 石切り場…この先ね。

source: Yup. Just 'round the back of this statue!
comment: うん、この像の裏手だよ～！

source: What are those glowing things, anyway?
comment:
それにしても…
 なに、あの光ってるの…？

source: I'm actually rather curious, myself.
comment:
ええ…
 ちょっと気になりますね。

source: A-hem!
comment: ──えっへん！

source: How does that thing even WORK?
comment:
まったく…
 どういうカラクリだ。

source:
That one's huge... What do you
 think they could be?
comment: 大きいな…本当に何なんだ？

source:
I don't know, but we'd better
 exercise a little caution.
comment:
判らん──だが、
 気を付けた方がよさそうだ。

source: Oh, we're back outside.
comment: あ、外に出たね。

source:
Ahhh... It's nice to be back
 in the great outdoors again.
comment:
ふう…
 少しホッとするわね。

source: Ah, isn't this...?
comment: おや、この建物は…

source:
Oh, this is where they publish the
 Imperial Chronicle newspaper.
comment:
《帝国時報》──
 おなじみの新聞社だね。

source:
So this is the opera house, huh?
 Might be nice to see a show sometime.
comment:
オペラハウスか…
 ちょっと興味あるな。

source:
You need to reserve your seats
 two months in advance, though.
comment:
入りたいのなら２ヶ月前から
 予約する必要があるぞ。

source: ...And that's just for the cheap seats!
comment: それでもＢ席だもんねぇ。

source:
Wow. A tiara encrusted with carnelians?
 This is about as ritzy as you can get.
comment:
紅耀石のティアラか…
 かなりの品みたいだな。

source: It's so shiny...
comment: ん…キラキラしてる。

source:
Here's the statue of Emperor Dreichels.
 He strikes quite a stately pose.
comment:
獅子心皇帝…
 威風堂々としたお姿だな。

source:
Weird to think he's the one
 who founded our academy.
comment:
ああ、俺たちにとっても
 縁のある人なんだよな。

source: Hmm... Looks like we've hit a dead end.
comment: ふむ…こちらは行き止まりか。

source: This area seems easy to get lost in.
comment:
うーん、土地勘がないと
 迷いそうだな。

source: That's three cats now.
comment: ネコ、これで３匹目。

source: Ahaha. What a little cutie.
comment: あはは、可愛かったね。

source:
There have always been a lot of cats
 around here. Not sure why, though.
comment:
…この辺りは
 なぜか猫が多いんだ。

source:
This would make a great training area.
 I envy the people who live around here.
comment:
ふむ、中々良い修行場所だ。
 帝都民がうらやましいぞ。

source:
...Only YOU would see an underground
 passage and think about training.
comment:
そんな感想を抱くのは
 間違いなく君くらいだぞ…

source: There's a light...
comment: 明かりが見えた。

source: The sound's getting louder, too.
comment: 音も大きくなってる…

source:
We must be getting
 close to the exit now.
comment: 出口が近いみたいだな。

source: Ahhh... What a pleasant evening.
comment: ふふ、良い夜だな。

source: It's pretty relaxing.
comment: ん…落ち着く。

source:
(No denying those two have
 some surprising similarities...)
comment:
（やっぱりこの２人、
  元々気が合うんだな…）

source: Being near water always helps me relax.
comment:
フフ…
 やはり水辺は落ち着くな。

source:
Oh, yeah. Your hometown is right
 on a lake, isn't it?
comment:
そういえば、ラウラの故郷は
 湖に面してるんだったか。

source: Esperanza?
comment: “えすぺらんさ”…？

source: I believe it means 'hope.'
comment: たしか“希望”という意味だな。

source:
This park is so peaceful, it's easy
 to forget we're in the capital.
comment:
のどかだな…
 帝都にあるとは思えぬくらいだ。

source: I could take a nap here.
comment: 昼寝したいかも。

source:
Ahaha. Yeah. People love to
 come here to relax.
comment:
あはは、一応、
 帝都市民の憩いの場所だからね。

source:
*sigh* Just coming here reminds
 me of last night's ordeal.
comment: はあ…昨夜は散々だった。

source: Sounds like you had a rough night.
comment: あはは…ご愁傷さま。

source: There are so many butterflies.
comment: 蝶、結構いるね。

source:
It really gives the place an
 exotic touch, huh?
comment:
ああ、ちょっと
 異国情緒があるな。

source: I wonder when that mechanism was made...
comment:
こういう仕掛けって、
 何時ごろ造られたのかな？

source:
I'm guessing a few hundred years ago
 at least. Probably during the Dark Ages.
comment:
たぶん数百年前…
 中世の暗黒時代じゃないか？

source: Those were difficult times back then.
comment: ふむ、戦乱の時代だな。

source: This area's full of water...
comment: 水が溜まってるね…

source:
I'll bet there's some way
 to drain it.
comment: ああ、どうしたもんかな。

source: Let's have a look around, then.
comment: 周りを調べてみるしか。

source:
This place seems like it goes
 on forever...
comment:
そ、それにしても
 とんでもなく広いよね…

source:
My father sure gave us a real
 humdinger of a job to deal with.
comment:
ああ…父さんめ、
 厄介ごとを押し付けたな。

source:
Well, I'm sure we must be
 getting close now.
comment:
はは…
 まあ、あと少しだろう。

source: Oh, there's the exit.
comment: あ、出口だ。

source: Haha. We're finally there.
comment: フフ、やれやれだな。

source:
Sure are more people out than
 there were yesterday.
comment:
しかし昨日よりも
 ずいぶん人出が多いな…

source:
They must've all come to see
 the Imperial family's parade.
comment:
あはは、皇族の方々の
 パレード目当てだろうね。

source: Grr... Those damn terrorists...
comment: くっ、テロリストめ…

source:
(Elise... Princess Alfin...
 Please be safe!)
comment:
（エリゼ、皇女殿下も…
  無事でいてくれ…！）

source: Monsters!
comment: 魔獣がいる…！

source:
No problem. We'll just
 cut our way through!
comment:

 clear, you could get a better view.

A cross inside a circle...

comment:
円に十字か…

No one really knows for sure. There

さて…諸説はあるが

Unfortunately, the meanings of most

If you crossed the lake, you'd be

This building is the Legram

この建物が、遊撃士協会、

Wow. I didn't think that door

That's the Ebel Branch Line--the

Haha. I remember playing in
 this river when I was young.
comment:
フフ、幼い頃はあそこで

comment: あー、船が来てるよ！

That's the ferry liner. It returns

comment:
水上定期船だ。

Ahhh. It's so cool here, you'd

comment: はー、夏なのに涼しいね～。

The weather's pleasant today.

comment:
天気もいいし、

Strutting around another lord's

comment:
気に喰わんな…

source: It sounds like there's a real VIP here...
comment:

source:
...Well, let's return to the manor

So this is St. Sandlot's old

ローエングリン城…

This is the first time I've come here

comment:
私も夜に来るのは初めてだ。

comment: 城の外壁のようだが…

月明かりで

An external corridor. We must be

Oh, another barrier. Let's see if we

(This all seems strangely

やっぱり人形兵器が

破壊されたゲートの向こうに

The path to the right leads deeper

要塞の奥は右手か…

This way leads to Marquis

ゼリカの堅物オヤジか。

都会っ子はだらしねえなぁ。

そういや、出る時に

She saw me leaving, but she just

comment:
ん、気付かれたけど

source:
Hmm... (Even the best maids

comment:
そ、そうか……

source:
This is where Claire said

ここは…

くっ、こうしている間にも

…帝国そのものの屋台骨が

ふむ、どうやらここは

迷う心配はねぇな。

comment:
いつもお世話になっていますし、

ん…歩数からすると

comment:
す、凄いな。

source:
This path's gotten real

comment:
さっきから随分と

ふむ、ひょっとしたら坑道を

やはりガレリア要塞と同じように

昨日は見かけなかった

外から引き込んだのかもしれない。

鉱山の出口…

この向こうで、領邦軍と
